messages:
rachel.prod: Quick heads-up  were opening a small regional GA for H100X Dedicated in eu-central-4 (Zurich). This is targeted at customers who prioritize balanced throughput and memory for medium-to-long context RAG and multi-shard infer.

rachel.prod: Why Zurich? Better latency for DACH customers + local compliance needs. Capacity is limited initially so routing will be opt-in.

tomo.eng: Short tech summary: H100X hosts are 2x H100X per server with tuned kernel set and NVLink mesh. Expect modest single-node memory improvements vs H100S and competitive throughput for 2k-8k token sequences. Internal perf: ~1.15x vs h100-ga on medium-context workloads.

tomo.eng: Important: KV cache placement is NUMA-sensitive on these hosts. Were shipping an allocator tweak in the next deploy to reduce tail-OOMs.

priya.ops: Rollout plan: pool tag h100x-eu-zurich-ga, soft GA today with per-tenant cap = 2 hosts. GA SLA applies. Initial capacity small (6 hosts). If customers need more cores, support request required. Billing tag: h100x-ga-eu; finance please finalize price multipliers.

priya.ops: NOTE: do not route production traffic until AE verifies quota. Post customer requests here so we can track approvals.

deploy-bot: [capacity-event] created pool h100x-eu-zurich-ga (pool-id: pool-h100x-zrh-01) by priya.ops at 2026-09-02T08:10:12Z

finance-bot: [billing-note] tag applied: h100x-ga-eu to pool pool-h100x-zrh-01 by priya.ops at 2026-09-02T08:12:00Z

jordan.sales: Sales heads-up: Ill circulate an AE-ready blurb calling out target workloads (medium-to-long context RAG, multi-shard inference). Limited capacity - emphasise approval workflow and per-tenant caps.

tomo.eng: Ops checklist:
```
- Add h100x-eu-zurich-ga to routing policy with fallback to h100-eu and a800-eu.
- Per-tenant cap default = 2 hosts; requests for increases via support only.
- Enable NUMA-aware KV allocator patch in next platform deploy (monitor closely).
- Emit memory-pressure and kv-eviction metrics to a dedicated tag (h100x-eu-metrics).
```

nto= (typo correction) tomo.eng: Example redwoodctl reserve command for QA:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --pool pool-h100x-zrh-01 --units 1 --duration 7d --justification "h100x eu-zurich eval"
```

devex-yuri: Ill update Dedicated quickstart and add a short compatibility note (preferred for 2k-8k seqs, NUMA-aware settings). ETA: tomorrow AM.

priya.ops: Action items: Tomo monitor perf/regressions for 2 weeks; Priya maintain quota list and publish weekly capacity snapshot in #eng-ops; Jordan prep AE comms; Finance finalize GA pricing. Post any customer access/approval requests here.

priya.ops: Pool health: GREEN (all nodes reporting)

tomo.eng: If you see OOMs or kernel timeouts tag @tomo.eng and include job id + sample input. If you hit unexpected NUMA evictions, set header X-NUMA-ALLOC=1 for testing and report.

jordan.sales: Will reach out to a couple enterprise accounts that requested EU-local high-memory hosts.

rachel.prod: Thanks everyone  will follow up with a short internal FAQ and access form link in the next 24h.
